name: Lawrence Globus
source:
A manager at the anti vampire organization at the church.
He's [url=/c12544]Juliet's[/url] mentor and boss.
He had one of his eyes gouged out by a vampire before he could defeat it and return alive, a vampire hunter with a long record of service.
